item.description: Please provide me with the following information on official languages and services in French since March 21, 2023:Copies of minutes of meetings of the Official Languages Steering Committee. All internal e-mails, Teams messages, text messages, iMessages, etc., which mention or refer to the Steering Committee. All e-mails, internal and external documents, Teams messages, text messages, iMessages, etc., concerning official languages and/or services in French. All e-mails, documents, Teams messages, text messages, iMessages, social media, etc., concerning complaints about French-language services or deficient signage in stations, at the head office, on ferries and all other MAI properties or locations (e.g. poorly translated or English-only signage). All e-mails, internal or external documents, Teams messages, text messages, iMessages concerning difficulties in recruitment of French-speaking employees. All e-mails, documents, Teams messages, text messages, iMessages that discuss issues related to bilingual candidates, only if these issues concern the French language or official languages. All e-mails, documents, Teams messages, text messages and iMessages relating to official languages in connection with the recruitment of potential candidates. | 1435 pages | Source: Marine Atlantic Inc.
